channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-ada
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: ipfs — via awesome-ada
item.description: InterPlanetary File System client library: CID/multihash/multibase, CAR archives with block verification, trustless HTTP gateway client.

item.title: gnat-patches — via awesome-ada
item.description: Curated GCC/GNAT patchsets against checksum-pinned upstream sources, each backed by an executable regression, published as patched native toolchain builds for GCC 13 through 16.

item.title: flyology-tui — via awesome-ada
item.description: Typed, declarative terminal user-interface toolkit for Ada.

item.title: flyology-simd — via awesome-ada
item.description: Portable, strongly typed SIMD foundations for Ada.

item.title: flyology-rdf — via awesome-ada
item.description: RDF 1.2 terms, streaming Turtle, TriG, N-Triples and N-Quads parsing, RDFC-1.0 dataset canonicalization, Notation3, and SPARQL 1.1 query syntax.

item.title: flyology-quic — via awesome-ada
item.description: Experimental bounded QUIC transport with protocol state, streams, loss recovery, and congestion control.

item.title: flyology-postgres — via awesome-ada
item.description: Client and server primitives for the PostgreSQL frontend/backend protocol, built on flyology task-aware I/O.

item.title: flyology-numa — via awesome-ada
item.description: Memory-node topology reporting, memory placement on a chosen node, and node-bound storage pools.

item.title: flyology-iri — via awesome-ada
item.description: Allocation-conscious URI, IRI, and WHATWG URL parsing.

item.title: flyology-http — via awesome-ada
item.description: HTTP/1.1 clients and servers with opt-in HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 engines and WebSocket support, built on flyology task-aware I/O.

item.title: flyology-debug — via awesome-ada
item.description: Bounded in-memory tracing, producer shards, retained batches, and persistent gauges.

item.title: flyology-cachelines — via awesome-ada
item.description: Cache-line-aware storage, ownership-aware groups, grouped arrays, and host cache queries.

item.title: flyology-bench — via awesome-ada
item.description: Adaptive microbenchmarking with balanced comparisons, diagnostics, baselines, and machine-readable reports.

item.title: flyology-allocators — via awesome-ada
item.description: Caller-owned buddy, best-fit, TLSF, and slab/span allocation algorithms with no hosted operating system dependency.

item.title: flyology — via awesome-ada
item.description: Experimental GNAT runtime extension for ordinary Ada tasking, adding task-aware I/O and an opt-in lightweight lane that runs designated tasks as fibers on shared event loops.

item.title: avoe — via awesome-ada
item.description: Ada Version of Emacs. A small Emacs-like editor for the Linux terminal. In the spirit of Jove: familiar Emacs keys.
